name: Psi Warrior

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A fighter with psionic power: shield allies, add Force damage and move things with the mind.

feature.name: Psionic Power
feature.summary: Psionic Energy Dice (4d6 to start) fuel Protective Field, Psionic Strike and Telekinetic Movement.
feature.text: You have Psionic Energy Dice (see the table; one comes back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest). Protective Field: as a Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, spend a die to reduce it by the roll + your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Psionic Strike: once per turn after you hit a target within 30 feet with a weapon attack, spend a die to deal Force damage equal to the roll + your Intelligence modifier. Telekinetic Movement: as a Magic action, move a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature within 30 feet up to 30 feet; once per rest, or spend a die.

feature.name: Telekinetic Adept
feature.summary: Psi-Powered Leap (fly briefly) and Telekinetic Thrust (Psionic Strike can knock Prone or push 10 feet).

feature.name: Guarded Mind
feature.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage; spend a die to end Charmed or Frightened at the start of your turn.

feature.name: Bulwark of Force
feature.summary: Bonus Action: give up to Int modifier creatures Half Cover for 1 minute.

feature.name: Telekinetic Master
feature.summary: Cast Telekinesis without a slot once per Long Rest and attack as a Bonus Action while concentrating on it.
